title: session-load --intake-real's check compares against a case no row has, and its real row starts fewer processes than the pinned hook
goal: session-load --intake-real's spawns row note and the benchmarks doc state that the real row is the intake hook cut at its INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S wait, so its spawns are not comparable with the pinned row's; intake_real_rows writes its spawns note from the module constant INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_load as b, bl_ci
rows = []
class FakeBench:
    reps = 1
    def clone(self, *a): return 'x'
    def row(self, scenario, case, arm, metric, value, n, note=''): rows.append((case, arm, metric, value, note))
b.hook_commands = lambda clone: ['x']
b.intake_hooks = lambda cmds: ['x']
b.replay = lambda *a, **k: {'hooks': [{'rc': 0, 'cpu_s': 1.0, 'wall_s': 2.0, 'children': [1, 2]}], 'load': 0.5}
b.intake_real_rows(FakeBench())
sp = [r for r in rows if r[0] == b.INTAKE_REAL_CASE and r[2] == 'spawns']
assert len(sp) == 1 and sp[0][3] == 3, ('the intake real spawns row is not the planted 3 processes', sp)
note = sp[0][4].lower()
assert getattr(b, 'INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE', None) == sp[0][4], 'intake_real_rows does not write bench_load.INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE as the spawns note'
for word in ('cut', str(bl_ci.INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S), 'pinned', 'not comparable'):
    assert word in note, ('the spawns note does not say the real row is the hook cut at its wait, not comparable with the pinned row', word, sp[0][4])
text = open('kb/_self/benchmarks.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
seg = text[text.index('`--intake-real` (with'):text.index('`--fs-usage FILE` (with')]
for word in ('cut', 'pinned', 'not comparable'):
    assert word in seg, ('the benchmarks doc paragraph of --intake-real does not say the real row is not comparable with the pinned row', word)

clauses.clause: session-load --intake-real's spawns row note and the benchmarks doc state that the real row is the intake hook cut at its INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S wait, so its spawns are not comparable with the pinned row's
intake_real_rows writes its spawns note from the module constant INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE

Measured: real 634-644 spawns, wall 50.1 s (= INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S), pinned 936-950; nothing shows an item check ran (bench_load.py:667-682). Behaviour repro: run session-load --arms A --reps 1 with and without --intake-real (a claude that exits 1 first on PATH) and compare spawns. Order: after BG-qm623dvn (both edit bench_load.py and the same paragraph of kb/_self/benchmarks.md, whose paid sentence and --intake-real sentence share one line, so a parallel landing conflicts at the rebase). Planning: the filed repro read a case name no row has and could not pass after a docs fix, so the repro now runs intake_real_rows on planted inputs (a stubbed replay and a fake bench object, no clone and no claude, about 0.1 s) and reads the --intake-real paragraph of kb/_self/benchmarks.md; run once on the base: exit 1 at the missing INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE. The comparison the title names lived in the check of ST-6zg57xiu, whose item file was deleted with its sprint, so nothing is repointed: the fix is the doc and the row note. The existing record keeps its old note until the next --intake-real run (a record is a measurement and is not rewritten).
